sexprīmi (also separately, sex prī-mi ; cf. decem primi, under decem), ōrum, m. sex-primus,
I.a board or college of magistrates in provincial towns, consisting of six members, Cic. N. D. 3, 30, 74; Inscr. Orell. 3756.—In sing., a member of such a board, Inscr. Orell. 3242.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
